verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed https://docs.snowflake.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Snowflake Documentation index. The docs also publish many section-level llms.txt files covering Snowpark, Streamlit, Postgres, data integration, Cortex Code, Snowsight, Native Apps, ML, SPCS and the developer guide, so an agent can be pointed at scoped, agent-oriented entry points. Missing for 10: independent or community evidence of agents actually consuming these files, and no evidence of a full-content variant such as llms-full.txt.
